title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Judges 15: Samson's revenge on the Philistines, with the three hundred foxes, the men of Judah, the jawbone and the spring at Lehi.

questions.text: What did Samson bring when he visited his wife at the time of wheat harvest?
questions.explanation: In the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat.

questions.text: Whom did his wife's father offer Samson instead of his wife?
questions.explanation: Her father said, "Isn't her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead."

questions.text: How many foxes did Samson catch?
questions.explanation: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes and put a torch between every two tails.

questions.text: What did the Philistines do to Samson's wife and her father?
questions.explanation: The Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.

answers.text: They drove them out of Timnah
They put them in prison in Gaza

questions.text: Where did Samson go to live after striking the Philistines hip and thigh?
questions.explanation: He went down and lived in the cave in Etam's rock.

answers.text: In his father's house in Zorah
In the cave in Etam's rock
In the hill country of Ephraim

questions.text: How many men of Judah went down to Samson to bind him?
questions.explanation: Three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam's rock.

questions.text: With what did the men of Judah bind Samson?
questions.explanation: They bound him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

questions.text: What did Samson use to strike a thousand men?
questions.explanation: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.

answers.text: A fresh jawbone of a donkey
A wooden club from a tree
The gate posts of the city

questions.text: What was the place called where Samson threw away the jawbone?
questions.explanation: He threw the jawbone out of his hand, and that place was called Ramath Lehi.

questions.text: What name was given to the place where God split the hollow and water came out for Samson?
questions.explanation: God split the hollow place in Lehi and water came out; therefore its name was called En Hakkore.
